title: The Guardian's Betrayal
next_chapter_hook: At the moment the Guardian entrusted his final wisp of remnant soul to Chen Ji, far away in the depths of the Xuanwu Sect Forbidden Grounds, a pair of eyes transcending cause and effect quietly opened—it had sensed that on the chessboard, a piece forgotten for ten thousand years was awakening.

text.content: In the depths of the ruins, the tremor of that jade pendant grew increasingly violent, as if the bloodline dormant for fifteen years was desperately summoning its master. Chen Ji knelt on one knee, his fingertips touching the cold jade surface, and a familiar aura that made his heart race flooded into his Mental Sea—it was Chen Nian's aura, the unique soul mark of his sister he had searched for countless years. "Niannian..." His voice was hoarse beyond recognition, yet his eye sockets were too dry to shed a single tear. Fifteen years of scheming and plotting, fifteen years of careful maneuvering, all now condensed into a single gentle call.

Suddenly, the stone walls around the ruins lit up with dense ancient runes, and a majestic pressure bore down like a collapsing mountain. Chen Ji's body sank, and the Tianji Record Fragment self-operated, barely resisting this terrifying momentum. Amid the dust, a hunched figure slowly materialized—a elderly man, his face withered like rotten wood, but deep within those turbid eyeballs burned an eerie green flame that belonged to no living being. "Those who trespass the forbidden grounds... die." The elder's voice was hoarse and hollow, yet on the final character it suddenly shifted, carrying an indefinable sorrow.

dialogue.content: The elder's gaze fell upon the faintly glowing jade pendant on Chen Ji's chest, his turbid eyes suddenly narrowing. "This aura... you are from the Chen family?" His tone became strange, the green flames flickering violently, "Ten thousand years... I've finally waited..." Before he finished speaking, his body suddenly stiffened, both hands gripping his own neck tightly, his face contorted into a mass, he howled, "No—it's not me—I can't—" The voice alternated between old and young, as if two completely different consciousnesses were tearing apart within the same body.

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes gleamed coldly, the Tianji Record Fragment flipped frantically, and within three breaths he had deduced the scene before him a thousand times. There were actually two consciousnesses within that elder—one forcibly implanted puppet consciousness, cold and mechanical; the other was the remnant original spirit, worn to fragments through endless years yet never completely dissipated. A cold smile formed at the corner of his mouth: "Fine technique. A figure from ten thousand years ago, enslaved as a puppet for an entire ten thousand years—the patience of that mastermind behind the scenes is truly remarkable."

dialogue.content: The elder's struggle gradually subsided, the green eyes regaining their hollow, icy quality. He stared directly at Chen Ji as if examining a trivial ant. "Chen family descendant... Tianji Record holder..." The voice had completely transformed into someone else—cold, imposing, utterly emotionless. "Designated piece number forty-nine, having fulfilled its historical role, is now to be retrieved." The words barely ended before countless runes in the sky transformed into endless chains, cascading down with overwhelming force.

text.content: Chen Ji retreated sharply, the Tianji Record Fragment bursting with brilliant radiance as a blurred prophetic vision flashed through his mind—in three breaths' time, these chains would pierce his limbs, sealing him into a puppet identical to the elder before him. He coldly smiled, fingers rapidly forming seals: "Designated number forty-nine? What grand airs. Unfortunately, I Chen Ji never operate by designated numbers." The Heavenly Secrets power gathered at his fingertips erupted violently, colliding with the overwhelming chains in a catastrophic impact that shook the entire ruin.

dialogue.content: Pressing forward through that brief confrontation, Chen Ji fixed his gaze directly on the elder's vacant eyes, his voice low and sharp: "Listen carefully, old thing. That thing inside you is called the Heavenly Eye—it treats all things in the world as pieces on a chessboard—including you, including those self-important talents of Xuanwu Sect, and including me. But it miscalculated one thing." A grim smile curved his lips. "The Tianji Record holder is never a piece, but the one who plays the game. You've been trapped here for ten thousand years—don't you want to know what that mastermind who controls your fate actually looks like?"

text.content: The elder's body trembled violently, the green flames in his eyes flickering erratically as something inside him seemed to be stirring to life. From his throat came hoarse sounds, like a soul suppressed for millennia struggling desperately: "I... I remember... those eyes... it's... it's not the end... above it... there's still..." Before he could finish, the green flames suddenly surged, the elder's face contorting into a mask of agony. "Xuanwu... Xuanwu Sect... there are... shadows..."

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. The Tianji Record Fragment trembled violently as a truth that made his back go cold was emerging—Heaven's Eye was not the end; above it existed higher-level beings, and Xuanwu Sect was precisely their projection in the mortal realm. He drew a sharp breath, forcing himself to remain composed, his gaze cutting toward the elder: "Tell me, what is that existence? You've been trapped here for ten thousand years—you should know better than anyone."

dialogue.content: The elder's body stiffened, then slowly raised his head, and on that withered face actually appeared a trace of human warmth. "It... it is called the Fate Weaver..." His voice grew ancient and weary, yet carried a sense of release. "Heaven's Eye is its eyes, Xuanwu Sect is its limbs and hands, and those so-called talented disciples... are merely its cultivated... blood offerings." His gaze fell upon the jade pendant in Chen Ji's hand, a complex emotion flickering in his eyes. "Child, your sister... she wasn't taken by the Holy Sect... she was chosen... to be a Fate Lock Key..."

choice.prompt: After learning the truth that Chen Nian had been selected as the "Fate Lock Key," Chen Ji faced a crucial decision:

choices.description: Help the Guardian break free from the Heavenly Eye's control, allowing him to relay all the secrets of ten thousand years with complete consciousness. As an exchange condition, the Guardian will become a key intelligence source for Chen Ji against higher-level beings.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the Guardian's complete memories and crucial intelligence against the Fate Weaver
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate consumption will accelerate Chen Ji's fate backlash

text.content: Without hesitation, Chen Ji urged the Tianji Record Fragment, a gentle yet resolute force flowing into the elder's Mental Sea. This was a function he had never used—not foresight of the future, but a traversal of the past. The Heavenly Secrets power surged like a tide, scouring away the cold puppet seal within the elder, emitting piercing shrieks. "Ten thousand years have passed..." Chen Ji's voice was soft, yet carried irresistible power. "You should awaken, Senior."

The elder's body trembled violently, and within those green eyes, two consciousnesses were fiercely battling. Finally, amid a heart-wrenching howl, that cold puppet seal was completely stripped away, dissolving into wisps of black smoke that scattered in the air. The elder straightened up, and in those turbid eyes finally appeared the vitality and light belonging to humans. "Good child..." A bitter smile appeared on his withered face. "I have waited for this day, waited for an entire ten thousand years."

choices.description: Since traces of the Heavenly Eye's mark still remain within the Guardian, keeping him will only become a hidden danger. Might as well take this opportunity to completely erase him, which can both weaken the enemy and obtain the residual Heavenly Secrets power within him.
choices.visible_cost: Lose the opportunity to obtain crucial intelligence
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the Heavenly Secrets Fragment within the Guardian, Strength enhancement
choices.risk_hint: May attract the Heavenly Eye's direct attention

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes turned cold, and the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly burst forth with blinding white light. He had never been a soft-hearted man, and since this guardian still carried the mark of those eyes within him, leaving him alive would bring endless trouble. "Since you've already become a puppet, there's no need for you to exist." Before the words even finished, a sharp force of Heavenly Secrets pierced through the old man's Mental Sea, grinding both the remnant consciousness and the puppet mark into dust.

However, the moment the guardian vanished, a cold voice exploded within Chen Ji's mind: "Unit 49, terminated. Chess piece 775, marked." The voice carried no emotion whatsoever, yet Chen Ji's blood nearly froze. He suddenly realized that his previous action had not freed him from the chess game's fate, but had instead drawn the Heavenly Eye's attention upon himself.

choices.description: Don't rush into a decision. First extract more intelligence about the Architect of Destinies from the guardian. Once I've obtained enough leverage, I'll decide whether to liberate him or completely annihilate him.
choices.visible_cost: Risk Missing the Optimal Action Window
choices.visible_reward: Obtain Deep Intelligence on the Connection Between Xuanwu Sect and the Architect of Destinies
choices.risk_hint: The puppet mark within the guardian may regain dominance at any moment

text.content: Chen Ji suppressed his killing intent, a meaningful smile curling at the corner of his lips. What he excelled at was never direct confrontation, but quietly understanding an opponent's trump cards amid casual conversation. "Since Elder has waited ten thousand years, surely you have much to say. How about this: you tell me intelligence about the Architect of Destinies, and in exchange, I'll help you find a suitable inheritor, so your will no longer needs to be trapped in this lightless ruins."

A gleam of sharpness flickered in the old guardian's murky eyes, as if touched by this proposal. He fell silent for a moment, then slowly spoke: "The Architect of Destinies... is an existence that transcends the Heavenly Eye. It doesn't interfere with individual fates, only weaves the laws of causality themselves." His voice dropped low. "And your sister Chen Nian... the reason she was chosen is because her bloodline carries the power of the first Tianji Record holder from ten thousand years ago. What the Architect of Destinies needs is not a chess piece... but a vessel."

The word 'vessel' struck Chen Ji's heart like a sharp blade. His expression remained calm, only the fingers gripping the Jade Pendant turning slightly white. For fifteen years, he had believed himself a meticulous strategist, playing all the heroes of the world in the palm of his hand, yet he had never imagined that the sister he had desperately sought would be merely a container for some terrible mission in others' eyes. "Whoever dares to be the vessel..." His voice was low and dangerous, a fierce killing intent flickering in his eyes. "I shall reduce them to ashes."

dialogue.content: The guardian looked at the determination in this young man's eyes and suddenly remembered himself ten thousand years ago—when he was still young, still believing that intelligence could defy fate. Yet in the end, he was utterly defeated, his very soul imprisoned in this confined space. "Child, the Architect of Destinies is not something you can oppose." The guardian's voice was aged and weary. "But it is not without weaknesses... it needs a vessel because it cannot descend directly upon this realm. Every ten thousand years, it must find a new host, or it will completely dissipate."

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils slightly contracted, and a mad plan rapidly took shape in his mind. The Architect of Destinies needed a host, and Chen Nian was precisely its chosen target—this meant that as long as Chen Nian existed, it would never strike at Chen Ji lightly. Conversely, as long as Chen Ji controlled Chen Nian's whereabouts, he would be gripping fate by the throat. A dangerous smile curled his lips: "Elder, many thanks for the guidance. It seems my sister... cannot be found for the time being."

dialogue.content: Upon hearing this, a complex expression of relief and worry appeared on the guardian's face. "You child... your depth of mind even exceeds what I had at your age." He sighed softly. "But do you know that the Architect of Destinies choosing your sister is not merely because of her bloodline?" He stretched out his withered finger, pointing at Chen Ji's chest. "The Tianji Record chose you, which means your sister must become a vessel. This is a chain of causality it has set up, linked ring upon ring, unbreakable by anyone."

choice.prompt: After learning the truth about the Tianji Record being connected to Chen Nian's fate, Chen Ji:

choices.description: Since the guardian knows all this, there's no reason for him to only reveal half. What else is he hiding? Chen Ji will use words to interrogate, prying open the final secrets of this ten-thousand-year remnant soul.
choices.risk_hint: The guardian may dissipate at any moment due to depleted power
choices.process_label: retreat to advance, press with words

text.content: Chen Ji收敛了所有情绪，calm地注视着守护者，那双眼睛深邃得仿佛能看穿一切虚妄。"前辈既然肯说这些，想必不打算把话烂在肚子里。"他的声音不疾不徐，"万年前你是如何落入天道之眼手中的？第一代天机录持有者又是什么人？陈念……她还有多少我不知道的秘密？"三个问题，步步紧逼，直指核心。

The guardian fell silent for a long while, a flicker of struggle passing through his murky eyes. Finally, as if having made some resolute decision, his voice came out hoarse and heavy: "Ten thousand years ago, I was no guardian... I was the first candidate vessel selected by the Architect of Destinies." A bitter smile appeared at the corner of his mouth. "It was only because I would rather die than submit that I was stripped of my vessel qualification and sealed within these ruins, lingering on. As for the first Tianji Record holder..." His gaze fell upon Chen Ji. "Her name was Chen Yao, your ancestral progenitor of the Chen family, and also... the first perfect creation of the Architect of Destinies."

choices.description: Since the Tianji Record and Chen Nian's fate were already destined, then accept it calmly. But this does not mean he would surrender—he would find the only opportunity for survival within this inescapable chess game.
choices.visible_cost: Temporarily Suppress Worry for His Sister
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the Guardian's Recognition and Inheritance

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, suppressing all the surging emotions in his heart. Anger, anxiety, fear... these emotions were useless, only affecting judgment. He raised his head, his gaze calm as still water: "Elder, I understand. The Tianji Record chose me, Chen Nian was designated as the vessel—this is all the layout of the Heavenly Fate Weaver." His voice had no fluctuation at all, "But I want to know one thing—how did the ancestor Chen Yao end up ten thousand years ago?"

A trace of surprise flickered in the guardian's eyes, quickly transforming into appreciation. "Good... what a composed child." he said softly, "Chen Yao... she did not become the vessel. Instead, she chose to die together with the Heavenly Fate Weaver. But she left behind one thing—" he pointed to the Tianji Record Fragment in Chen Ji's hand, "This fragment is the last trace of primordial power she shed when she perished. With her life, she tore herself free from the Heavenly Fate Weaver's chess game." The guardian's voice grew solemn, "And you are the only person in ten thousand years qualified to inherit this power."

As his words fell, the guardian's form began to fade, a sign that his remnant soul was about to dissipate. His time was running out. "Child..." the guardian's voice became distant, "This remnant soul of mine has persisted for ten thousand years, all to pass down the truth. Now... my mission is complete, I should go." His gaze fell upon the Jade Pendant on Chen Ji's chest, a gentle light flickering in his eyes, "替我... take care of that child for me. Being chosen as the vessel was not her fault..."

dialogue.content: The guardian's form grew more illusory, the ghostly green flames extinguishing bit by bit. "There is... one more thing..." his voice came in fragments, as if it might dissipate in the wind at any moment, "Xuanwu Sect... beneath the Forbidden Grounds... hides... the passage leading to the Heavenly Fate Weaver's true body... that is... the only..." Before he could finish, his body suddenly shuddered, and in those turbid eyes, a final brilliant light burst forth, "Remember... you are not a piece... you are... the chess player..."

text.content: With a thunderous sound, the guardian's body dissolved into countless specks of light, drifting like fireflies through the ruins. Chen Ji watched this scene silently, his eyes utterly serene. Ten thousand years of time, countless causes and effects—all ultimately reduced to a handful of dust. He slowly extended his hand, catching a speck of light that had not yet vanished. That speck was warm and gentle, as if carrying the guardian's final warmth. "Elder, farewell." His voice was very soft, barely audible, "The cause you left unfinished, I will complete for you."

The moment the specks of light completely vanished, an ancient jade slip appeared in Chen Ji's palm out of thin air. The jade slip was entirely black, its surface covered with dense ancient runes, emanating an aura entirely different from yet subtly resonating with the Tianji Record. Chen Ji pressed the jade slip against his brow center, and a massive stream of information instantly flooded into his Mental Sea—that was the crystallization of the guardian's lifetime of learning, the key to opposing the Eye of Heavenly Law and the Heavenly Fate Weaver. "Elder..." Chen Ji gripped the jade slip tightly, a cold, fierce smile curling at the corner of his mouth, "Rest assured, the era belonging to the pieces... should end."

choice.prompt: After obtaining the guardian's inheritance, Chen Ji decided on his next course of action:

choices.text: Immediately head to the Xuanwu Sect
choices.description: The Forbidden Grounds passage revealed by the guardian before his death is the most important clue at present. Although the risk is extremely high, time waits for no one—Chen Nian's fate could be rewritten at any moment.
choices.visible_cost: Insufficient preparation may lead to falling into danger
choices.visible_reward: Seize the initiative, may find Chen Nian ahead of schedule
choices.risk_hint: The Xuanwu Sect is guarded by powerful enemies such as Han Lie

text.content: Chen Ji did not hesitate, rising to leave the ruins. The guardian's dying words still echoed in his ears—the Xuanwu Sect's Forbidden Grounds hide a passage leading to the Heavenly Fate Weaver's true body. This was both crisis and a rare once-in-a-millennium opportunity. If he could find that passage before the enemy noticed, perhaps he could fundamentally break this dead game that had been stagnant for ten thousand years. "Han Lie..." he murmured that name, a cold light flickering in his eyes, "恰好，去会会这位老对手。"

dialogue.content: Just as Chen Ji was about to step out of the ruins, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly grew scalding hot, and a blurry image appeared in his mind—the Xuanwu Sect's Mountain Gate, a familiar figure surrounded by layers of formations, that was Su Qingyao. She had somehow pursued him here, but was trapped by the Xuanwu Sect's Mountain Protection Array, her situation critical. Chen Ji's footsteps halted, a playful smile curling at the corner of his mouth: "Interesting... this Inner Disciple Senior Fellow is truly relentless."

choices.description: The jade slip left by the guardian contains massive information; acting rashly will only fall into the enemy's traps. Might as well find a safe place, thoroughly digest this intelligence, then formulate a meticulous plan.
choices.visible_cost: May miss the optimal timing to rescue Chen Nian
choices.visible_reward: Obtain a more complete intelligence system, strategic planning greatly enhanced
choices.risk_hint: The enemy may make moves during this period
choices.process_label: find safe place to study jade slip

text.content: Chen Ji forced himself to stop his footsteps. Impulse was a mistake only the weak would make. The guardian had spent ten thousand years laying out this chess game, never to have it squandered in an instant. He sat cross-legged in the ruins, pressed the jade slip against his brow center, his divine sense sinking into it. In an instant, massive information surged forth like a tide—accumulation spanning ten thousand years, comprehension of heavenly principle operations, research on the Heavenly Fate Weaver... Chen Ji absorbed all of this ravenously, the brilliance in his eyes growing brighter and brighter.

After an unknown length of time, Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes. Deep within his gaze, something seemed to have subtly changed—that was a deeper comprehension of the ultimate principles of heaven and earth. He looked down at the jade slip in his palm, a satisfied smile curling at the corner of his mouth: "The elder indeed kept something in reserve... hidden within this jade slip is a secret technique to conceal one's aura. If mastered, even the Eye of Heavenly Law would find it difficult to peer into my whereabouts." He stood up, his gaze turning southeast, toward the direction of the Xuanwu Sect, "Next, it's time to go see my 'old friend'."

choices.description: Holy Sect Saintess Ye Qing's "Demonic Path Mists" can conceal the Tianji Record's aura, serving as a powerful weapon against the Eye of Heavenly Law's surveillance. Rather than risk danger alone, it's better to first contact this reliable ally.
choices.visible_cost: Need to share part of the intelligence with her
choices.visible_reward: Gain a powerful assistance ability, greatly reducing the risk of action
choices.risk_hint: May expose more trump cards to allies

text.content: Chen Ji took out a pitch-black communication jade talisman, that was the contact method Ye Qing left for him. The communication methods of the Demonic Path and the righteous path were entirely different, the Heavenly Secrets Eye was extremely difficult to track. He injected a strand of divine consciousness into the jade talisman, briefly transmitting a message: In three quarters of an hour, meet outside the forest to the east of the ruins, there is important business to discuss. After a moment, the jade talisman slightly heated up, Ye Qing's reply only had four words: "Set out immediately."

Three quarters of an hour later, a graceful figure appeared outside the forest. Ye Qing was dressed in black gauze, her brow carried a bit of solemnity, upon seeing Chen Ji she directly spoke: "I sensed an abnormal fluctuation—the aura of the Heavenly Secrets Eye had briefly intensified half an hour ago, then disappeared again." Her gaze fell on Chen Ji, her brow furrowed, "What did you do? Actually startled those eyes?"

Chen Ji did not hide anything, briefly telling Ye Qing everything that happened in the ruins. Of course, regarding Chen Nian's part he glossed over it, not that he distrusted this ally, but some things, the less one knows the safer. After Ye Qing finished listening, she was silent for a long while, complex emotions flickering in her profound eyes. "Heavenly Fate Weaver... an existence beyond the Heavenly Secrets Eye..." she murmured, "It seems our previous speculation was still too conservative." She raised her head, her gaze burning as she looked at Chen Ji, "What do you plan to do?"

Chen Ji raised his head to gaze at the distant horizon, there was the direction of Xuanwu Sect, behind the layers of clouds and mist, one of the most dangerous secrets of this world was hidden. His gaze was deep and calm, as if everything was under control. "Beneath the Xuanwu Sect's forbidden grounds, a passage leading to the main body of the Heavenly Fate Weaver is hidden." His voice was very light, yet carried unwavering determination, "I am going there, not to seek death, but to find a way to break this dead chess game." He turned to look at Ye Qing, a strange light flickering in his eyes, "Of course, before that, I need you to help me with something—use your Demonic Path mist to cover my aura."

Ye Qing quietly watched this man before her, a feeling difficult to describe arose in her heart. When they first met, she thought he was nothing more than a deep-thinking strategist, skilled at calculating people's hearts; when they met again, she discovered he was actually the holder of the Tianji Record, carrying shocking secrets; and at this moment, she finally realized, this person before her was by no means willing to be merely a chess piece. What he wanted was to overturn the entire chessboard, to personally control fate. "Alright." she softly agreed, black mist spreading from around her, enveloping the two of them, "I will accompany you on this journey."

Demonic Path mist churned, completely concealing the auras of both. Chen Ji gazed at the direction of Xuanwu Sect, a cold light flickering in his eyes. The chess game the Guardian had set up over ten thousand years, he intended to end in one year. Whether the Heavenly Secrets Eye or the Heavenly Fate Weaver, whoever dared to touch his sister Chen Nian should prepare to be erased from the chessboard. "Let's go." he spoke softly, his figure flickering, disappearing into the vast night, "This game, it's our turn to place a piece." Ye Qing followed closely behind, Demonic Path mist following like a shadow, completely integrating this strange pair into the darkness.

The ruins returned to dead silence, only that jade pendant still quietly lay in the dust, emitting a faint glow. As if waiting for something, or as if warning of something. In the distance, the direction of Xuanwu Sect, thunder light flickered dimly, that was the unique phenomenon when the mountain protection formation was triggered—someone had already set foot in that forbidden land first. And that person seemed to have an inseparable connection with Chen Ji's purpose for this journey. The gears of fate were accelerating their rotation.
